about.title: Founded in 2004 on hard work and craftsmanship
text: Rockstar Welding was founded in 2004, built on hard work and a dedication to excellent service, quality and craftsmanship.
We invested in a workshop so we can design, fabricate and finish our materials in-house, and custom fabrication is the heart of our business.

Our work can be seen at government and municipal facilities, educational institutions and commercial properties in North Texas, and if something isn't up to par, we promise to do everything we can to make it right.
